description: This file defines a Dart class 'RestClient' that provides methods to perform HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT) with JSON encoding/decoding, handling authorization tokens, and error handling through custom exceptions. It serves as a wrapper around the http package to facilitate RESTful API interactions within a Flutter or Dart project.

classes.name: RestClient
classes.description: A client for making HTTP requests to a REST API, managing headers, authorization tokens, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: RestClient
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the RestClient with optional custom http client and base URL.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Sets the authorization token used in request headers.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a complete Uri from a path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Generates headers for HTTP requests, including JSON content type and authorization if present.

methods.name: getJson
methods.description: Performs a GET request expecting a JSON object and decodes it into a Map.

methods.name: getJsonList
methods.description: Performs a GET request expecting a JSON array and decodes it into a List.

methods.name: postJson
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON body and returns a decoded JSON object.

methods.name: putJson
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with a JSON body and returns a decoded JSON object.

methods.name: _decodeJsonMap
methods.description: Decodes a response body into a Map, throwing an ApiException on error or unexpected format.

methods.name: _decodeJsonList
methods.description: Decodes a response body into a List, throwing an ApiException on error or unexpected format.
